findings.title: Book a visit button is an icon with no accessible name
findings.severity_rationale: Rubric default Critical for a functional image with no name; it is the first step of the Book a visit path and already the top level.

instances.device: Pixel 7 emulator (sdk_gphone64_x86_64), Android 16, API 36, 420 dpi, 1080x2400 px

findings.user_impact: The only way into booking is a "+" icon button with no content description and no text. TalkBack announces it as "Button" (or "Unlabelled, button"), so a screen reader user has to guess that it books a visit.
affected_users: Voice Access users, who have no name to say
findings.remediation: Give the FloatingActionButton a label: Icon(Icons.Default.Add, contentDescription = "Book a visit"), or an ExtendedFloatingActionButton with visible text.
findings.verification_step: Re-run run_mobile_audit.py on S01: label.icon-button-no-name and label.control-no-name pass for book_fab; with TalkBack on, the FAB is read as "Book a visit, button".

findings.title: Book a visit button exposes no name to assistive technology
findings.severity_rationale: Rubric default Serious for a control with no name, one level up because book_fab starts the Book a visit path.

instances.device: Pixel 7 emulator (sdk_gphone64_x86_64), Android 16, API 36, 420 dpi, 1080x2400 px

findings.user_impact: The same control as F-1, under 4.1.2: the button's role is exposed but its name is empty, so assistive technology cannot tell users or voice commands what it does.
findings.remediation: The fix for F-1 fixes this too: one content description on the FAB.
findings.verification_step: As F-1: uiautomator shows content-desc "Book a visit" on the clickable node.

findings.title: Booking hint text is light grey on white (2.32:1)
findings.severity_rationale: Rubric default Moderate for low-contrast secondary text; the hint is information about booking, not a step on the path.

instances.device: Pixel 7 emulator (sdk_gphone64_x86_64), Android 16, API 36, 420 dpi, 1080x2400 px

findings.user_impact: "Bookings open six weeks ahead" is #AAAAAA on #FFFFFF, 2.32:1 against the 4.5:1 minimum. With the system dark theme on, the app keeps its light colours, so the same ratio was measured in dark mode (M004).
affected_users: Anyone using the phone in bright light
findings.remediation: Use a darker grey, #767676 or darker (4.5:1 on white), or the theme's onSurfaceVariant colour; follow the system dark theme so the hint stays legible there too.
findings.verification_step: Re-run run_mobile_audit.py on S01: contrast.text and contrast.text-dark pass for booking_hint.

findings.title: Booking instructions are cut off at a large font size
findings.severity_rationale: Rubric default Serious for text lost when enlarged, one level up because the instructions are on the booking screen of the Book a visit path.

element.label: Choose a day and we will call you to confirm the time.

instances.device: Pixel 7 emulator (sdk_gphone64_x86_64), Android 16, API 36, 420 dpi, 1080x2400 px

findings.user_impact: At font scale 2.0 "Choose a day and we will call you to confirm the time." is clipped to its first line: intro_box has a fixed 40 dp height (84 px of it for the text, at both scales) while the other text on the screen grew 1.66 times. The part people lose is the line saying the clinic will call to confirm.
affected_users: People who use large fonts (low vision, older users)
findings.remediation: Remove the fixed height(40.dp) on intro_box (use heightIn(min = 40.dp)) so the text can wrap to more lines.
findings.verification_step: Re-run run_mobile_audit.py on S03: text_scaling records no text-scale.not-enlarged result; at font scale 2.0 the whole sentence is visible in the screenshot.

findings.title: Home screen is locked to portrait
findings.severity_rationale: Rubric default Serious for an orientation lock; the lock is on the home screen only (Booking rotates), and the path still works in portrait, so no critical-path step.

element.label: Harbour Dental Gentle care for nervous patients Our clinics Harbour Street Mon to Fri, 8am to 6pm Northside Tue to Sat,

instances.device: Pixel 7 emulator (sdk_gphone64_x86_64), Android 16, API 36, 420 dpi, 1080x2400 px

findings.user_impact: With landscape requested the home screen stays portrait. The manifest sets android:screenOrientation="portrait" on MainActivity. People with a device mounted in landscape (wheelchair mounts) have to read the home screen sideways.
affected_users: People with the device mounted in a fixed orientation
findings.remediation: Remove android:screenOrientation="portrait" from MainActivity in AndroidManifest.xml and check the layout in landscape.
findings.verification_step: Re-run run_mobile_audit.py on S01: the orientation probe finds a landscape screenshot.

findings.title: Date picker traps keyboard focus and ignores Back
findings.severity_rationale: Critical: 2.1.2 is a non-interference criterion. It blocks the Book a visit path for keyboard and switch users, so P0.

instances.device: Pixel 7 emulator (sdk_gphone64_x86_64), Android 16, API 36, 420 dpi, 1080x2400 px

findings.user_impact: In the Pick a day dialog, Tab keeps focus on "Mon 16 Nov" (six presses), and Escape and then Back leave the dialog open: a hardware-keyboard or switch user can neither move to another day nor leave. Tue 17 Nov and Wed 18 Nov are never reached.
affected_users: TalkBack users navigating with a keyboard
findings.remediation: Remove the onPreviewKeyEvent handler that consumes Tab, Escape, Back and Down in the dialog, set dismissOnBackPress back to true, and close the dialog in onDismissRequest.
findings.verification_step: Re-run run_mobile_audit.py on S04: keyboard.sequence moves through day_0, day_1 and day_2, and Escape closes the dialog.

findings.title: Promotion banner changes by itself with no way to pause it
findings.severity_rationale: Critical: 2.2.2 is a non-interference criterion. It is not a step of the Book a visit path.

instances.device: Pixel 7 emulator (sdk_gphone64_x86_64), Android 16, API 36, 420 dpi, 1080x2400 px

findings.user_impact: The banner advances every 3 seconds through three promotions: its pixels changed between the 5 s and 7.5 s screenshots, and the screen has no pause, stop or hide control. People who read slowly lose the text, and the motion distracts people with attention difficulties.
affected_users: People with attention or cognitive disabilities
findings.remediation: Stop auto-advance (let people swipe), or add a visible pause button; also stop it when the system "Remove animations" setting is on.
findings.verification_step: Re-run run_mobile_audit.py on S01: the motion probe records no change between 5 s and 7.5 s, or finds a pause control.

advisories.title: Help button is below the Android 48 dp target guideline
advisories.note: help_button measures 24.4 x 48 dp: it is above the 24 dp minimum of WCAG 2.5.8 but below Android's 48 x 48 dp recommendation. The icon was drawn at 20 dp; Compose's minimum interactive size padded the target.
advisories.remediation: Give the Help icon a 48 x 48 dp touch target (IconButton does this by default).

needs_review.what_to_check: uiautomator does not expose heading semantics. With TalkBack on, check that "Harbour Dental", "Our clinics", "Book a visit" and "Pick a day" are announced as headings and that heading navigation (TalkBack reading controls) moves between them.

triage.reason: Same element and colours in dark mode: the app ignores the system theme. Kept as one finding, one instance.

crashes.title: Opening a clinic map freezes the app for 12 seconds (ANR)
steps: Launch the app
Tap "Harbour Street" or "Northside" in Our clinics
Wait: the screen is blank and input is ignored; Android shows "isn't responding" after 5 s
log_excerpt: 705   848 I WindowManager: ANR in ActivityRecord{52034231 u0 au.example.harbourdental/.MapActivity t30}.  Reason: Input dispatching timed out (Application does not have a focused window).
crashes.replay: reproduced 2/2 for each of C01, C02 and C03 after pm clear
crashes.fix: MapActivity.onCreate blocks the main thread (Thread.sleep(12_000) at MapActivity.kt:29 in the source; frame MapActivity.onCreate in the ANR trace). Load the map tiles off the main thread (a coroutine on Dispatchers.IO) and show a progress indicator.
crashes.verification: Re-run explore.py: tapping either clinic row reaches S02 with no ANR, and replay finds none.
crashes.tier_rationale: B1: in C01 the app was killed after Wait; in C02 and C03 it recovered. Reach 2: a sampled screen, not the Book a visit path.

crashes.title: Rotating the booking screen with the date picker open crashes the app
steps: Launch the app
Tap the "+" button (book_fab)
Tap "Pick a date"
Rotate the device to landscape
log_excerpt: 12791 12791 E AndroidRuntime: java.lang.RuntimeException: Unable to start activity ComponentInfo{au.example.harbourdental/au.example.harbourdental.BookingActivity}: java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method 'java.lang.Class java.lang.Object.getClass()' on a null object reference
crashes.fix: BookingActivity.onCreate dereferences a saved value that is never saved (savedInstanceState.getString("draft_day")!! at BookingActivity.kt:56 in the source). Save draft_day in onSaveInstanceState, or treat a missing value as no draft (getString("draft_day") ?: return).
crashes.verification: Re-run explore.py and crash_explore.py --replay: rotating S04 reaches a landscape booking screen with the dialog, and no crash is recorded.
crashes.tier_rationale: B1: the process dies; relaunch works (restart). Reach 3: the dialog is a step of Book a visit. Likelihood state_change: it needs a rotation (or any configuration change, such as a font or dark-mode change, while the picker is open).

steps: Check help mechanisms (contact details, chat, FAQ link) appear in the same relative order on every page that has them. Do it on each screen (S01 to S04) with TalkBack on where it applies.
Record the outcome per screen: passed, failed with a new finding, or inapplicable with why.

manual_test_plan.title: Labels or Instructions
manual_test_plan.why_untested: No automated check covers this criterion on Android in this version.
steps: Check every input has a visible label or instructions, including formats and required fields. Do it on each screen (S01 to S04) with TalkBack on where it applies.
Record the outcome per screen: passed, failed with a new finding, or inapplicable with why.

manual_test_plan.title: Status Messages
manual_test_plan.why_untested: No automated check covers this criterion on Android in this version.
steps: Trigger status messages (search results count, cart updates, form saved); check they are announced without moving focus. Do it on each screen (S01 to S04) with TalkBack on where it applies.
Record the outcome per screen: passed, failed with a new finding, or inapplicable with why.

assisted_review.method: Read the base and marked screenshots and the hierarchy of every sampled screen, the crash screenshots and the replay records.
notes: The hero art (a Canvas drawing with no node in the tree) is decorative and correctly absent from the hierarchy: no candidate.
The clinic rows' chevrons are small icons inside full-width clickable rows (200 px tall): the row is the target, and the checks did not flag them.
On S01 the app draws edge to edge and the "Harbour Dental" title sits under the status bar clock; not a WCAG failure on its own, worth fixing with window insets.
Dark mode: the app does not follow the system theme (M004 measured the same colours).

limitations: iOS was not run: it needs macOS with Xcode 15 or later; this host is Windows.
Google's Accessibility Test Framework was not run (its instrumentation APK is not built in this version); the skill's own checks cover labels, target size and contrast.
One emulator only (Android 16, API 36); no physical device, no other OS versions or screen sizes.
S02 (map): the motion and dark-mode probes errored because uiautomator could not dump the frozen screen (X-1); orientation was blocked on S02 and S04 by recorded crashes.
No screen reader was simulated: reading order and announcements are in the manual test plan.
Random exploration (monkey) was off; four screens were found by guided exploration within 13 actions.

The release build is minified: crash and ANR frames show R8 line numbers (MapActivity.onCreate:6, BookingActivity.onCreate:21); the source lines cited in the fixes come from the example's source, which an installed-build audit would not normally have.
